source: int_trips_valid x dim_zones (is_cbd = config/zones_cbd.csv) in the warehouse
cbd_rule: dim_zones.is_cbd: the 60th St geometric rule plus the three harbour-island overrides (103-105); fee check of PLAN Phase 1 extended to trips
share_definition: trips with cbd_congestion_fee > 0 / trips with a non-NULL fee

groups.i_both_outside: pickup and dropoff zone both outside the CBD (dropoff known)
groups.ii_pickup_or_dropoff_inside: pickup zone or dropoff zone inside the CBD
groups.outside:dropoff_zone_unknown: pickup outside the CBD, dropoff id 264/265 (reported separately, in neither group)

manhattan_zones.note: area_share_south_of_line: share of the zone polygon south of the 60th St line (cbd.area_share_south); 0 < share < 1 = the zone straddles the line
